rooms.name: An Immortal Room
rooms.desc:
This is a starting point for all of us who don't need doors or walkways to get
around.  There is a map floating in the nothingness here for some guidance.

rooms.name: A large beach
rooms.desc:
You are on a large, serene beach. To the west lies the ocean, from which waves
occasionally raise up from to lap against the sandy shore. To the south you see
a line of tropical trees, where the tropical forest is. The beach extends to
your north.

rooms.name: A large beach
rooms.desc:
You are currently positioned on a large beach. The sandy ground is soft, making
moving difficult. Far to the south you can see a line of trees signifying the
tropical forest. The beach stops close to the east, marking the normal terrain.
Someone has written something in the sand here, in giant letters.

rooms.name: A large beach
rooms.desc:
You are on a big, sandy beach, it would be a great place to go if you ever took
a vacation from adventuring. The waves lap against the shore, creating soothing
sounds, and you begin to relax. The beach runs north and south and the edge of
the tropical forest begins to the east.

rooms.name: A large beach
rooms.desc:
This part of the beach curves softly to the south and to the east, forming a
kind of wall around the tropical forest. The sandy ground is soft, and it is
a little hard to walk on with all your weight, but you are sure that, if you
were attacked, it would not hamper you in any way.

rooms.name: A large beach
rooms.desc:
This part of the beach seems more weathered, and there are many footprints that
have been left here by previous passerbys, some abnormally large, some insanely
small. Someday the waves will reach up to the highest part of the beach and
wash it all away, and there will be no evidence of any passing. The edge of the
tropical forest is south of here, and the beach runs east and west.

rooms.name: A large beach
rooms.desc:
You are on a large, sandy beach which runs east and west. To the south you see
the edge of a tropical forest, which is the only shelter you can see. The white
sand is soft and you walking through it is hard, but you feel that if you were
forced to defend yourself, your experience would overcome the terrain. To the
east the beach starts curving north.

rooms.name: A large beach
rooms.desc:
This part of the beach is wider than the other parts, reaching at least double
the length of the rest of the beach towards the mainland. The sand here is
soft, the result of being so distant from the water, which constantly laps at
the shore.

rooms.name: A large beach
rooms.desc:
The beach here is littered with sharp, jagged rocks. The sand has partially
buried most of them, leaving only the cruelly razorlike edges poking out of
the ground, ready to impale your feet. The waves crash against the rocks with
tremendous force, and you know one day the rocks will be eroded down to small
pebbles.

rooms.name: A large beach
rooms.desc:
The ground here is tougher than the rest of the beach, making your footing
stable. The beautiful blue ocean spreads out for miles to the north and west,
and to the south and east the beach continues.

rooms.name: A large beach
rooms.desc:
From your current position you can look north and see the miles and miles of
endless sea. To the east and west the beach continues, and to the south is the
edge of a tropical forest.

rooms.name: A large beach
rooms.desc:
The beach here is loud and noisy, a combination of the waves slamming
themselves against the sandy shore and the violent river a little to the east.
To the south lies the edge of a tropical forest, and the beach continues to
the west.

rooms.name: A large beach
rooms.desc:
The sound of a raging river comes from west of here. That, combined with the
waves forever crashing into the beach and the occasional strange noise emitted
from the south make this part of the beach very noisy. To the north you can
see a sand bar, to the west you see a river, and the beach continues east.

rooms.name: A sand bar
rooms.desc:
This is just a little mound of sand that stands above the water level. There
is room to move around and you could lay down and relax and listen to the
sounds of the ocean surrounding you for a while. All in all it is a very serene
spot.

rooms.name: A large beach
rooms.desc:
Here the waves have carved out a large pool in the sand. In the pool you can
see all sorts of tiny organisms moving around, making the pool look like some
sort of soup. The beach continues east and west and the edge of the tropical
forest is to the south.

rooms.name: A violent river
rooms.desc:
This is the part of the river that feeds into the oceans, the fresh water here
will eventually become completely absorbed into the sea, tainted with salt and
other materials that will make it a totally different water. The river runs
south from here, and the beach lies to the west and east.

rooms.name: The edge of a dark tropical forest
rooms.desc:
Directly to the east is a dense tropical forest, and a large beach stretches
out to the west. Lush, green bushes grow here among the tall grass that grows
between the beach and the tropical forest, forming somewhat of a buffer zone.

rooms.name: The edge of a dark tropical forest
rooms.desc:
You are standing on the edge of a dark tropical forest. It stretches for miles
to the east. There is a long beach to the west of you and the lush green
bushes and shrubs you are in continue to the north and south. Strange noises
emanate from the tropical forest and the strange wildlife within.

rooms.name: The edge of a dark tropical forest
rooms.desc:
You are standing at the corner of the barrier between the thick, tropical
forest which begins south east of here and the beach that stretches out in
all other directions. From here you can see past the beach and out to sea.

rooms.name: The edge of a dark tropical forest
rooms.desc:
You are standing in the tall grasses and lush green bushes that make up a
barrier between the large beach to your north and the thick, tropical forest
that begins directly south of you. You can hear the waves crashing against
the shore far away.
